chunks: He had surely seen Him on the clear horizon.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'the clear horizon' in Surah At-Takwir?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal for affirming the reality of the Prophet's visionary experience (ru'ya) during the Mi'raj or the initial revelation, distinguishing it from mere imagination. Scholars such as Al-Tabarsi and Al-Kulayni emphasize that 'clear horizon' (al-ufuq al-mubin) refers to a specific, visible location in the celestial realm, validating the physical or spiritual sight of the Divine or Gabriel. This supports the Shia doctrine of the Prophet's infallibility (Ismah) and his unique capacity to perceive higher realities without error.
